source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 275 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 275 was established by Ordinance No. 19666, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 16, 1987. Ordinance No. 19666 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19666 was amended by Ordinance No. 21847, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 13, 1993. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19666; 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 275 is established on property generally fronting on the south line of Park Lane, west of the west line of Boedeker Street. The size of PD 275 is approximately 4.4381 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19666; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 275A). (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.105. USES.

The only main uses permitted on the Property are single-family and private street uses. All dwelling units must be detached. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.106. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

No structure may be more than 28 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Dwelling Units
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.107. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF DWELLING UNITS.

The Property is limited to a maximum of 14 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.108. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

Maximum coverage allowed on any residential lot is 65 percent. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.109. SETBACKS.

Front, side, and rear yard setbacks for each structure must conform to the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.110. PARKING.

Parking for the residential uses on the Property must be provided in accordance with Chapter 51. Visitor parking may be provided in the center of the cul-de-sacs in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Open Space
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.111. OPEN SPACE.

A minimum of 6,400 square feet of landscaped common area must be provided in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Screening Wall
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.112. SCREENING WALL.

A solid brick or masonry screening wall eight feet in height must be constructed along Park Lane in accordance with the development plan. A minimum of seven trees with a minimum caliper of three inches must be provided between the wall and Park Lane in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.113. SIDEWALKS.

Sidewalks must be constructed in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.114. SIGNS.

One detached sign that identifies the development is permitted in accordance with the development plan. No other detached signs are permitted except for real estate signs, political signs, or signs displaying non-commercial messages. (Ord. Nos. 21847; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19666; 21847; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-275.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 275 is located on Zoning Map No. F-8. (Ord. Nos. 19666; 25711)
